summary: Frontend-only targeted verification completed for new 3D bottom-bar/share icons, Home Explore tile containment, and Home↔Reader regression. Core flows passed; one accessibility-state gap found on tab buttons.

ui_bugs.issue: Selected accessibility state is not exposed as aria-selected/aria-current on web for tab-home/tab-explore/tab-saved/tab-profile during navigation checks.

action_items: Expose tab selected accessibility on web (ensure active tab maps to aria-selected=true or aria-current=page for screen readers).
Keep current icon assets/mappings unchanged: verified tab source paths nav-home/nav-topics/nav-profile + shared act-bookmark pair + ending share act-share-v2.
critical_code_review_comments: Code wiring is consistent with requirements: Saved tab and Reader Save both use BOOKMARK_3D shared constant.
Tab icon asset paths and Explore/Share updates are correctly implemented in source; no hardcoded external URLs found.
Accessibility gap observed at runtime: selected state not surfaced in DOM attributes despite tab role.
seed_data_creation: Guest-only flow used; no seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated guest onboarding -> Home deck loaded; all four tabs navigate; icon crossfade active/base works; tab tap targets ~93.8x58 (>44pt). Home Explore art is fully inside container with positive margins and no overlap/overflow at 320/390/430; Explore tile opens Topics. Reader ending reached; share icon src is /assets/?unstable_path=.%2Fassets%2Fimages/act-share-v2.png; like/save/share handlers executed without runtime crash in browser; save banner appears; story-morph detached and no stuck overlay after ending-home return; Saved tab showed persisted bookmarked content in same run.
rca_of_issue: Repro: navigate tabs and inspect active tab node attributes. role=tab is present, but aria-selected/aria-current remain null for all tabs. Likely RN-web accessibility-state mapping not propagating on this custom Pressable tab implementation. Mitigation: explicitly set accessibilityState + web-focused ARIA prop mapping on active tab in custom tab bar render path.
